strings.step_aside_tuning: Keel ship tuning is off: {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_sailing: Keel Sailing is off: {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_catalog: Keel ships and pens are off: {0} is installed.
strings.off_no_crucible: Keel is off: this server does not run Meadworks.
strings.off_no_keel: Keel is off: this server does not run Keel.
strings.recipe_invalid: Keel: the {0} recipe was refused ({1}); the default recipe is used.
strings.skill_sailing_description: Health of the ships you build, speed of the ships you steer, and how far you explore at sea.
strings.ship_fast_karve_description: A light, narrow karve under an oversized sail: faster than a longship, with a small hold.
strings.ship_fast_longship_description: A lean longship under an oversized sail: the fastest ship, lightly built, with a smaller hold.
strings.ship_knarr_description: A wide cargo longship: slower and sturdier than a longship, with a much larger hold.
strings.ship_busse_description: A wider, longer cargo ship: slower still and sturdier, with a bigger hold.
strings.ship_big_busse_description: The largest cargo ship: the slowest and sturdiest, with the biggest hold.
strings.ship_small_byrding_description: A longship with a fenced deck pen for a few animals.
strings.ship_byrding_description: A larger longship with a deck pen for a small herd.
strings.ship_greater_byrding_description: The largest livestock ship, with a high-fenced deck pen for big animals.
strings.gate_refused_moving: The gate stays shut while the ship is underway.
strings.wind_called: The wind turns toward the {0} for {1} s.
strings.wind_called_self: You turn the wind toward the {0} for {1} s.
strings.wind_called_by: {0} turns the wind toward the {1} for {2} s.
strings.square_wind_text: {0} strength. The arrow shows where the wind blows, seen from where you face.
strings.cfg_multipliers__health_multiplier_help: Multiplier on the health of every ship, on top of the per-ship value. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_multipliers__sail_force_multiplier_h: Multiplier on the sail force of every ship, on top of the per-ship value. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_multipliers__paddle_force_multiplier: Multiplier on the paddle force of every ship, on top of the per-ship value. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_multipliers__turning_multiplier_help: Multiplier on the turning force of every ship, under sail and at the oars, on top of the per-ship value. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_multipliers__damage_taken_multiplier: Multiplier on the damage every ship takes; 0 means no damage, on top of the per-ship value. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_multipliers__build_cost_multiplier_h: Multiplier on the materials every ship costs (each material rounded, at least 1; free ships come from Timber's Free Build cheat), on top of the per-ship value. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_pens__containment_speed_help: Ship speed in m/s above which the invisible lip along a deck pen's rails keeps jostled animals aboard. At rest the lip is gone so animals can leave.
strings.cfg_pens__gates_open_at_rest_only_help: On: a pen gate refuses to open while the ship moves faster than Containment Speed. Closing always works.
strings.cfg_sailing__sailing_enabled_help: Every Sailing perk, Wind Call, Lookout and Sailing experience. Off keeps everyone's Sailing level.
strings.cfg_sailing__ship_health_at_100_help: Percent more health for a ship built by a level 100 sailor, fixed by the builder's level when the ship is placed.
strings.cfg_sailing__ship_speed_at_100_help: Percent more top speed, under sail and at the oars, for a ship a level 100 sailor steers.
strings.cfg_sailing__exploration_radius_at_100_h: Percent larger map exploration radius while a level 100 sailor is aboard a ship (the game's radius is 100 m).
strings.cfg_sailing__helm_experience_per_kilomet: Sailing experience per kilometer a ship travels while you steer it. 0 turns it off.
strings.cfg_sailing__crew_experience_share_help: Percent of the helmsman's experience everyone else aboard earns while someone steers. 0 turns it off.
strings.cfg_wind_call__wind_call_level_help: Sailing level that unlocks Wind Call. 0 gives it to everyone; above 100 turns it off.
strings.cfg_wind_call__wind_call_duration_help: Seconds the called wind blows for everyone aboard that ship.
strings.cfg_wind_call__wind_call_cooldown_help: Seconds before the same player can call the wind again.
strings.cfg_wind_call__wind_call_key_help: Turns the wind to blow the way you look while you steer a ship. Your own key.
strings.cfg_wind_call__gamepad_wind_call_help: Gamepad chord for Wind Call (Crucible pad buttons joined by +). Empty: none, so nothing collides with steering.
strings.cfg_lookout__lookout_level_help: Sailing level that unlocks Lookout. 0 gives it to everyone; above 100 turns it off.
strings.cfg_lookout__lookout_radius_help: How far from the ship the Lookout pulse reaches, in meters.
strings.cfg_lookout__lookout_duration_help: Seconds the enemies the pulse reached keep their name tags for everyone aboard.
strings.cfg_lookout__lookout_cooldown_help: Seconds before the same player can send the next pulse.
strings.cfg_lookout__lookout_key_help: Sends the Lookout pulse while you are aboard a ship. Your own key.
strings.cfg_lookout__gamepad_lookout_help: Gamepad chord for Lookout (Crucible pad buttons joined by +). Empty: none.
strings.cfg_display__ship_panel_help: A panel under the minimap while you are aboard: speed, speed against vanilla, exploration radius and your Sailing abilities.
strings.cfg_display__speed_unit_help: How the ship panel shows speed: meters per second (MetersPerSecond), knots (Knots) or kilometers per hour (KilometersPerHour).
strings.cfg_display__boat_camera_max_distance_he: How far the camera may zoom out while you steer, in meters. 16 is the game's own limit; try 24 for the biggest ships.
strings.cfg_display__sail_opacity_help: Sail opacity of the ship you steer: 1 as the game draws it, lower is see-through, 0 hides it. Other ships are unchanged.
strings.cfg_display__sail_opacity_both_sides_hel: Off: only the side of the sail you see from the rudder is see-through. On: both sides.
strings.cfg_display__sail_opacity_on_deck_help: Sail Opacity always applies at the rudder. On: also anywhere on the deck.
strings.cfg_display__name_vanilla_ships_help: Vanilla rudders and holds name their ship too: "Use rudder (Karve)", "Karve Storage".
strings.cfg_cheats__ashlands_immune_ships_help: Cheat. The ships on Ashlands Immune List sail the burning Ashlands ocean unharmed. This removes the progression gate that makes the Drakkar necessary, with the ocean effects and world key it triggers.
strings.cfg_cheats__ashlands_immune_list_help: Ship prefab names separated by commas, or * for every ship. Acts only while Ashlands Immune Ships is on.
strings.cfg_cheats__invulnerable_ships_help: Cheat. The ships on Invulnerable List take no damage of any kind: hits, collisions, weather or the Ashlands ocean.
strings.cfg_cheats__invulnerable_list_help: Ship prefab names separated by commas, or * for every ship. Acts only while Invulnerable Ships is on.
strings.cfg_cheats__tailwind_help: Cheat. The wind always blows from behind the ship you steer, for you alone: your sail fills whichever way you head. Other players' wind is unchanged.
strings.cfg_cheats__fast_sailing_help: Cheat. The ship you steer sails at up to twice its top speed. Acts on the machine that moves the ship, which is usually the helmsman's.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__enabled_help: Off hides the Fast Karve from the hammer. Ships already built stay.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__recipe_help: Up to five Prefab:Amount pairs separated by commas. An invalid recipe or an unknown item keeps the default and logs why.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__width_help: Hull width relative to the vanilla Karve.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__length_help: Bow-to-stern length relative to the vanilla Karve.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__scale_help: Size of the whole ship in all three dimensions; Width and Length multiply on top.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__cargo_columns_help: Columns of the ship's hold. A smaller hold never deletes items: a non-empty hold is not shrunk.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__cargo_rows_help: Number of storage rows in this ship's hold.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__sail_color_help: Hex RRGGBB multiplied into the sail; FFFFFF leaves it as it is. Loaded ships change at once.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__hull_color_help: Hex RRGGBB paint multiplied into the hull planks (not the mast or rudder); empty keeps the vanilla planks.
strings.cfg_fast_karve__hull_stripes_help: Painted bands on the hull; 0 paints it solid.
